description: Na₄HfGaSi₂PO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.91 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.93 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.95 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.71 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.12 Å. Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ga-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-39°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-37°. There are three shorter (1.64 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond length. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent HfO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-35°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ga, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Hf, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ga, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramid. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ga, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramid. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one Ga, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Hf, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Hf, and one Si atom to form distorted ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃GaSi trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one ONa₃HfSi trigonal bipyramid.
